column7: REVIEW-SERVERGUARD-RECOVERYKEY-1 F5: a SQLite \"file:\" URI spelling of the database path (file:/p, file:///p, file://localhost/p, percent-encoded, relative, with a query) opens the same database as the plain path but named a different sidecar lock, so a server and an admin command spelling it differently both held the guard; a real database under a \"mode=memory\" directory got none (TestSQLiteModeMemoryDirectoryName_StillLocked, internal/serverguard/serverguard_uri_spelling_test.go).
